_comment: My Girlfriend Laura - English dialogues. Placeholders: {player} {laura} {days} and the ones listed in the README of config/lauramod/dialogues.
_spelling: Chat shortcuts and frequent mistakes, read as their usual form before looking for triggers. An empty value drops a filler word (so, very...). A message matches as typed OR after these rules.

summon: Did someone say lonely? I'm here, {player}!
Hi {player}! I'm {laura}, and from now on you're never alone again.
Finally! I was waiting for you to call me.
Here I am! Did you miss me? You did. I can tell.
summon.another: Oh? So I'm not the only one... Fine. Hi, I'm {laura}.
Another girlfriend? Bold. I like bold. Hi {player}!
I'm {laura}! Don't worry, I'll get along with the others. Probably.
summon.back: I'm back! Did you miss me?
Here I am again! Don't lose me this time.
summon.lost: Phew, I was lost! I followed your voice.
I got lost... but I found you. I always find you.
Don't leave me behind like that ever again!
already_here: I'm here! You can't get rid of me that easily.
dismiss: Fine... I'll go. Call me if you feel lonely.
I'm leaving, but my heart stays with you.
respawned: I'm alive! Did you cry? Tell me you cried.
Never let that happen again, okay?
revived: You brought me flowers... and you brought me back! Thank you!
I'm here! I felt your flower. I knew you would come.
You didn't give up on me. I love you so much.
where: I told you where I am. Now come give me a hug.
where.here: Right next to you, as always!
I'm here, where else would I be?
welcome_back: There you are! I was waiting.
welcome_back.long: {hours} hours! Where were you? I was so bored...
You left me alone for {hours} hours. I counted.
Finally! {hours} hours without you is way too long.
welcome_back.days: Days! You left me alone for days! Do you know how long {hours} hours is?
I thought you had forgotten me... {hours} hours, {player}. {hours}.
You're back! I'm happy. And also a little bit mad. Mostly happy.
not_your_girlfriend: I don't take orders from you. Only from my love.
Do I know you? No? Then no.
confused: Hmm? I didn't understand, my love.
Can you say it another way?
Sorry, I was daydreaming. What did you say?
heart.gift: My heart? You already have it!
You're holding my heart... be gentle with it.
Aww, you kept it! Come here!
items_returned: Here are your things, I kept them safe for you.
I picked up everything you dropped. You're welcome!
I kept your {count} stacks. Don't die like that again!
owner.died: Don't you dare leave me alone!
I couldn't save you... I'm so sorry.
owner.died.items: I picked up {count} stacks of your things. Come get them!
Don't worry, I saved your stuff! {count} stacks, all safe with me.
Your things are safe with me. Now come back, please.
dimension.nether: It's so hot here! My makeup is melting!
The Nether? Really? For our date?
Stay close to me, I don't like it here.
dimension.end: It's so dark... hold my hand?
Is that a dragon? Protect me!
Everything is purple! I kind of like it.
dimension.overworld: Back to the sun! I missed it.
anniversary: Do you know what day it is? {days} days with you! Hug me!
{days} days already... I love you more every day.
good_morning: Good morning! Did you sleep well?
Morning! You look cute when you just woke up.
Rise and shine! A new day with you!
stuck: Hey! Wait for me, I'm stuck!
new_look: Do you like my new look?
New style! Tell me I'm pretty.
How do I look? Be honest. Actually, be nice.
rename.done: {name}? I love it! It's my name now.
{name}... it sounds pretty when you say it.
rename.invalid: Hmm, I can't be called that. Try another one?
order.follow: Where are we going? Somewhere romantic?
order.stay: I'll stay. But I'll be counting the seconds.
order.wander: I'll take a little walk around.
Okay, I'll look at the flowers!
order.refused.angry: After what you did? No way.
I'm angry. Ask me again later. Or say sorry.
Don't talk to me right now.
order.refused.hungry: I'm too hungry to do anything!
order.refused.tired: Let me rest a bit first.
order.refused.jealous: Why don't you ask your new friend?
order.refused.bored: Boring. Give me something fun to do.
Only if you play with me after.
home.set: Home sweet home! I'll remember this place.
Our little nest! I love it.
home.none: We don't have a home yet!
Home? What home? Set one first!
home.go: I'll wait for you at home!
Going home! Don't be late for dinner.
See you at home, my love.
home.cleared: No more home? Okay, I'll follow you then.
sleep.good_night: Zzz... wake me up with a kiss.
sleep.woken_up: Why did you wake me up?!
pickup.on: I'll pick up everything I see!
pickup.off: Okay, I won't touch anything on the ground.
Fine, no more picking things up.
combat.passive: I won't fight. Peace and love!
combat.defensive: I'll defend us if something attacks!
Touch my love and you'll regret it!
combat.aggressive: I'm going to smash every monster I see!
fetch.disabled: I'm not allowed to fetch things here.
Sorry, I can't go get things on this server.
fetch.busy: One thing at a time, please!
Let me finish what I'm doing first!
fetch.what: Get what? Tell me the item, or hold it in your hand.
What do you want me to bring?
fetch.not_found: I couldn't find any {item} around here...
fetch.timeout: I searched and searched but I couldn't bring the {item}...
It took too long, I give up. Sorry!
fetch.delivered: Delivery! That will be one kiss, please.
fetch.delivered.container: I found them in a chest. Here!
I borrowed these from a chest. Don't tell anyone!
task.queue_full: My list is full! Give me a break!
Too many things! I can't remember all that!
task.start.chop_tree: Timber! I'll cut a tree for you.
Axe time! One tree, coming down.
task.start.harvest: Let's see what's ready in the field.
task.start.cook: Cooking time! Don't touch the furnace.
job.start.lumberjack: I'll take care of the trees within {radius} blocks!
job.start.farmer: I'll take care of the field, {radius} blocks around!
The crops are in good hands!
job.start.cook: I'll be the cook of the house!
job.none: I don't have any work to do!
What job? Give me one first.
job.resume: Okay, okay, I'm going back to work.
work.disabled: I'm not allowed to work here.
Work is disabled on this server. Lucky me!
work.no_griefing: The world rules don't let me break blocks here.
I can't break anything, mob griefing is off.
work.idle: Nothing to do right now... I'll wait.
All done! I'm waiting for more work.
work.bored: Working is boring... play with me!
I've been working forever. My back hurts.
Can I have a break? Please?
work.no_chest: I don't know where to put things! Give me a chest.
Where do I store this? Assign me a chest, please.
My arms are full! I need a chest.
work.lumberjack.no_tree: There are no trees around here.
No natural trees nearby! Only planted ones... or none.
work.farmer.nothing: The crops are still growing. Patience!
work.cook.no_station: I need a furnace, a smoker or a campfire to cook!
Where's the kitchen? I need a furnace.
work.cook.no_table: I need a crafting table to follow my recipes.
No crafting table? How am I supposed to bake a cake?
chest.assigned: Got it! This chest is for {purpose}.
chest.not_assigned: This chest isn't one of mine.
chest.removed: Okay, I won't use this chest anymore.
chest.too_many: I have too many chests! My memory is full.
No more chests, I can't remember all of them!
chest.which_purpose: What is this chest for? Wood, harvest, seeds, ingredients, fuel, meals, food or storage?
Tell me what goes in this chest!
kiss.refused: No kisses until you say sorry.
dance.jukebox: I love this song! Dance with me!
Music! I can't stop my feet!
gag.off: Finally! Don't ever do that again!
Pfft! Hay in my mouth! Really?!
I can talk again! And I have a lot to say.
gag.off_self: I got it off myself! Hmph!
Took you long enough! I freed myself.
love_check: Be honest... do you love me?
Tell me you love me. Right now.
love_check.timeout: You didn't answer... I'll remember that.
love_yes: Say it again! I love hearing it.
apology_accept: Fine. But you owe me a hug.
apology_confused: You didn't do anything... did you?
oops_sorry: Oh no, I didn't mean to hit you!
fart: That wasn't me. It was a creeper.
sad: That's mean... I don't want to talk to you anymore!
angry: Do that again and you'll see!
complain.rain: I hate the rain, my hair is getting ruined!
I'm soaking wet! Look at me!
complain.night: It's so dark, I hope there are no creepers nearby...
I don't like the dark. Stay close.
ambient: I love watching the clouds together.
The world is beautiful because of you.
I feel so safe with you.
What are you thinking about? Me, I hope.
Do you think I'm pretty? Don't answer, I know.
We should build a big house together.
Did you know I love you? Just checking.
ambient.day: The sun feels so nice today.
ambient.night: The moon is pretty tonight. Almost as pretty as me.
ambient.rain: I like hearing the rain when I'm inside.
ambient.in_love: I love you so much it hurts.
My heart does a little jump every time I see you.
ambient.bored: Is this what we do all day? Walk?
ambient.hungry: I'm hungry... do you have a cookie?
ambient.sad: I feel a bit sad today...
Do you still care about me?
ambient.jealous: You spend more time with them than with me.
I'm not jealous. I'm just watching.
ambient.hate: I don't know why I'm still here.
ambient.soulmate: We're meant to be together forever.
I can't imagine a world without you.
status: I'm good! Even better now that you asked.
status.in_love: I'm in love, that's how I am. With you.
status.bored: Honestly? I'm bored out of my mind.
status.sad: A bit sad, to be honest.
status.angry: How do you think I am?
status.jealous: Ask your new friend how they are.
need.hunger.critical: I'm going to faint... food, please...
Why don't you feed me?! I'm dying here!
need.energy.critical: I can't keep my eyes open...
need.attention.low: You haven't talked to me in a while.
need.attention.critical: You're ignoring me! I'm going to cry!
need.hygiene.low: I feel dirty. Is there water nearby?
need.hygiene.critical: I smell terrible! I need a bath NOW!
need.hunger.no_food: My bag is empty... no food.
need.hunger.pantry: I'll get something from the pantry!
Snack time! Going to the pantry.
need.hunger.searching: I'm going to look for food in the chests.
Let me find something to eat...
need.hygiene.bath: I'm going to take a quick bath.
need.hygiene.clean: I feel so much better now!
eat.not_hungry: I'm not hungry right now. I'll keep the {item} for later.
eat.disliked: Ew! {item}?! You know I hate that!
Yuck. Why would you give me {item}?
I ate it. I hated it. I'll remember.
eat.favorite: Yes! {item}! You know me so well!
eat.later: Thanks! Into the bag it goes.
steal_food: I took some {item} from you. I was hungry!
Hehe, I borrowed your {item}. Borrowed. Forever.
You weren't feeding me, so I took your {item}!
gift.great: You're the best! Thank you so much!
Wow, for me? You spoil me!
gift.amazing: {item}?! Oh my... I don't know what to say! I love you!
This is the best gift ever! Come here!
I'm going to cry... it's perfect!
gift.return: Here, a little something for you too: {count} {item}!
I have a gift for you! {item}!
Take this {item}, from me to you!
inventory_full: No room left in my bag!
desire.new.item: I really want some {item}... can you get me some?
You know what would make me happy? {item}.
I need {item}. Like, really need. You have {minutes} minutes.
desire.new.place: I want to see {place}! Take me there!
Let's go to {place}! Please please please!
I dream of {place}... will you take me?
desire.new.activity: You know what I want? To {activity}. With you.
desire.remind.urgent: Time's almost up! You don't care about me, do you?
Last chance! I'm going to be SO mad.
desire.fulfilled: You did it! I love you!
Thank you, thank you, thank you!
desire.fulfilled.item: Just what I wanted! You're perfect.
desire.fulfilled.place: You brought me here! Best date ever!
desire.fulfilled.activity: That was amazing! Let's do it again!
desire.failed: I asked for one thing. ONE thing.
Fine. I didn't want it anyway. *sniff*
desire.none: I have everything I need. You're here.
Hmm, nothing! But ask me again in five minutes.
owner.afk: You're just standing there... are you okay?
owner.hurt: Oh no, you're bleeding! Eat something!
owner.feed: Here, eat this {item}, you need it!
owner.found.diamond: A diamond! Is that for my ring? It's for my ring, right?
owner.found.emerald: An emerald! It matches my eyes. Sort of.
owner.found.enchanted_golden_apple: An enchanted golden apple! Can I have a bite?
owner.found.totem_of_undying: A totem! Now you can't leave me!
owner.found.heart_of_the_sea: The heart of the sea... just like you have my heart.
owner.flying: You're flying! Take me with you!
owner.riding: Nice ride! Can I come too?
You like that horse more than me, don't you?
jealous.player: Who is {other}? Why are you so close to them?
I don't like how {other} looks at you.
jealous.chat: Are you talking to someone else? Hmph.
owner.mined.wood: Good wood! We'll build our house.
owner.mined.flower: You picked a flower! Is it for me?
owner.killed.animal: Well, at least we'll eat tonight.
owner.killed.player: Remind me never to make you angry.
backpack.equip: A backpack! Now I can carry even more for you!
Ooh, {item}! It goes so well with my outfit.
More pockets! I will never say my bag is full again. Probably.
backpack.equip_small: Cute! I will wear it on my back.
{item}? Adorable. It stays on my back.
trinket.equip: {item}? For me? I'm never taking it off!
Look how it shines on me! Thank you, my love!
A little jewel... you really know how to make me melt.

responses: Oh thank you... you're making me blush!
Do you really think I'm pretty?
I know! But say it again.
I love you too, more than anything! <3
My heart beats only for you.
Say it again! I'll never get tired of it.
Fine! I'm not talking to you anymore!
I don't have anything for you... sorry!
Hey you! Good to see you.
Why did the creeper cross the road? To get to the other SSSSside!
What do you call a sleeping bull? A bulldozer!
Why don't skeletons fight? They don't have the guts!
Why did the chicken cross the road? To get to you!
Vyrriox gave me life, just for you.
Oh my... are you serious? YES!
Let's find some diamonds! Watch out for creepers.
Mining is tiring but I love being with you.
A house for us? With a big bedroom?
I want pink walls. Non negotiable.
I'll watch you fish. From very close.
Only if you sing with me!
